name: FINTEL Vatuwaqa Communications Centre (VCC) colocation environment
notes: FINTEL official pages (checked 2026-08-12) describe secure, resilient, scalable data-center colocation facilities at VCC for mission-critical IT/network infrastructure, plus cable landing station facilities, Satellite LEO Gateway/SNP hosting (power/cooling/backhaul) and telehousing. VCC is Fiji's international gateway and cable landing station operator (Southern Cross, Tonga Cable, ICN1, Tui-Samoa, Gondwana 2, Google Tabua/Bulikula). FijiIX is hosted at VCC (UNESCAP 2022 presentation). Classify as cable hub + colocation-adjacent telecom; no public MW/rack specs; not general commercial colocation beyond FINTEL's stated offerings.

name: Telecom Fiji Limited data-centre and colocation services
notes: TFL official ICT Solutions page (methodology-verified 2026-08-12) confirms cloud services, co-location for disaster recovery, data centres, and hosted PABX. Grade A for service existence; physical site, address and capacity not disclosed. Suva locality from directories is Grade C only.

name: Vodafone Fiji Hosted Cloud / IaaS (Fiji-based hosted cloud)
notes: Vodafone Fiji official IaaS page (methodology-verified 2026-08-12) describes a Fiji-based hosted cloud service connected to Vodafone IPVPN. Operator-hosted cloud lead; physical data-centre site and capacity undisclosed. Division assigned Central by convention (Vodafone Fiji HQ Suva); actual site unverified.

name: Fiji Government Data Centre (Berkley Crescent, Suva)
developer: Fiji Government (Ministry of Information / ITC Services)
notes: ITU ICT in Sustainable Development award page (checked 2026-08-12) states the first Government Data Centre was commissioned in April 2011 by Prime Minister Bainimarama, with ICTs overseeing construction and commissioning; government directory locates the Data Centre Building on Berkley Crescent, Suva. Government facility, not public commercial colocation; capacity undisclosed.

name: Datec Fiji datacentre site services / digital infrastructure
notes: Datec official site (checked 2026-08-12) markets datacentre site services from Suva (infrastructure management, testing/commissioning, micro and modular datacentre solutions) and software-defined datacentre solutions. Service/integrator lead rather than a published carrier-neutral facility; no MW/rack specifications.

name: Telecom Fiji NextGen Data Centre
notes: TFL issued an Expression of Interest for qualified investors/partners for Fiji's first next-generation, internationally accredited, sustainable data centre; Fiji Times (2025-11-17) quotes TFL head of ICT Shalvin Narayan that construction would take about 24 months starting in 2026; Fiji Global News (2025-11-16) corroborates. EOI existence Grade A (LinkedIn preserved); schedule Grade B. Site not disclosed; assigned Central per first-round convention (TFL Suva base).

name: Savusavu eCentre cable landing station (prefabricated data centre)
notes: Fijian Government commissioned Flexenclosure (announced 2018-01-22) to build an eCentre cable landing station in Savusavu, Vanua Levu, connecting to the Tui-Samoa cable; Flexenclosure describes eCentre as prefabricated data-centre technology; later TFL/Ciena reporting confirms the Savusavu-Labasa fibre backbone. Telecom/cable-landing infrastructure rather than commercial colocation; no public power/white-space specs.

name: Google Natadola ICT facility / cable landing station with data transmission infrastructure
notes: PM Office release (2024-11-30): PM Rabuka officiated the groundbreaking at Natadola, Nadroga Province; facility will house a new cable landing station plus data transmission servers/racks and power generating equipment for Google's international fibre optic cables; Viti Levu's second landing station complementing the Central Division landing. DCD (2024-12-02) frames it as CLS/ICT facility, not a hyperscale data centre; no Grade A commissioning or service source found as of 2026-08-12, so keep under construction. TFL (2025-06-09) to design/build/maintain the Vatuwaqa-Natadola terrestrial fibre link. Capacity null; not a Google Cloud public region. Search for commissioned/operational/RFS evidence returned none (negative control).
